messages:
maria_cs: FYI BlueHarbor just opened a ticket — account suspended for overdue invoice INV-2026-0423. They claim they've already submitted PO PO-99823; attached screenshot in support ticket. Says card on file was declined.

alex_fin: Checked — invoice shows 'invoice terms: PO required'. No PO attached to invoice record. We attempted automated card charge (last4 4242) and got `card_declined` from Stripe. Decline code: 402. Charge attempt logged: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0423

jess_support: Customer says their procurement routed PO to vendor portal on 2026-03-15 and provided ref PO-99823. Support ticket 7892 has their upload which is just a scan of the PO header, vendor name mismatch. I've asked them to re-upload with matching vendor name and signature.

CollectionsBot: Dunning notice 3 sent to billing@blueharbor.com on 2026-03-20 09:12 UTC. Service suspension window expires in 48h. Automatic suspension performed at 2026-03-22 17:04 UTC per policy.

sam_ops: Can we do a manual short-term re-enable while Finance/Legal validate PO? Customer says disruption blocks production. If we re-enable, suggest we put a 72h temporary hold and require cleared payment or verified PO to avoid chargeback risk.

carlos_fp: I don't want to override unless we get a valid PO or successful payment. If they insist they sent the PO, we need the signed document and matching billing address. Also if VAT was applied incorrectly we can issue a credit once validated. Invoice shows VAT 20% applied; customer claims they are VAT-exempt (EU reverse charge) and provided VAT ID in support thread but not yet validated.

anna_legal: If PO is part of their internal compliance, contract's section 5.2 says PO acceptance only required for customers with enterprise billing; confirm their plan. If they were on self-serve, PO terms might not apply. Need account tier check before changing state.

maria_cs: Account is on 'Dedicated-Standard' enterprise plan (ID BH-3301). PO requirement is valid. They've been escalated to enterprise sales last quarter, so PO should have been used.

alex_fin: Action items: 1) Support to request a new upload of PO with exact billing/legal name matching our contract and the invoice. 2) Finance to attempt one more auth with customer's updated card details (if they provide) and hold suspension for 72h pending result. 3) Legal to verify VAT ID if provided. I'll hold on re-enable until we get PO or cleared payment.

jess_support: Noted. Pinged customer for a re-upload and asked for a payment method update link: https://billing.redwood.ai/pay/BH-3301. I've also added a note to ticket 7892 to include a screenshot of procurement confirmation.

BlueHarbor (via support rep): "We did send PO-99823 on 2026-03-15 to billing@redwood.ai — we have a receipt from our procurement portal. Request urgent access restoration."

maria_cs: @alex_fin @anna_legal please confirm ETA on decision. Customer is threatening to cancel contract if service remains down.

alex_fin: I'll review within the hour. If they provide signed PO + matching VAT ID, we can lift suspension for 72h. Otherwise we keep suspended until payment/PO validated.

anna_legal: I'll check contract and VAT registry now, will update in thread.

CollectionsBot: Manual action pending: override_suspension_request by alex_fin at 2026-03-22 17:20 UTC (pending approvals).

carlos_fp: FYI if we re-enable, set a tag on the invoice for manual review and do not auto-collect for 7 days. That keeps audit trail.

maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll keep customer updated. Ticket is the source of truth: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/7892
